about: The bench catalogue entries this course's bench blocks name, in exsight-benches' catalogue/catalogue.json shape (M68f). Copied from that file, never edited by hand: the compiler checks a work against them when a build is given no --benches.

schema.title: Draw Bench drawing (.benchdrawing)
schema.description: A drawing the Draw Bench opens: its artboard, layers, items, groups and steps, the author's Preview capture, and the stamp the bench wrote when it saved it. A compiler checks the file against this schema, then the stamp's source against "sha256:" and the hex SHA-256 of the document's canonical JSON without "stamp" (keys in code-point order, no whitespace); once they match, stamp.derived.steps is the block's derived steps and stamp.diagnostics what the drawing's checks said, and the bench is never run.
